response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including geospatial projects (GISCollective), low-latency systems (Dunnhumby), and distributed architectures. However, his primary expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript, D, and Node.js, with limited evidence of modern C++ or Rust experience required for the role. While his background includes geospatial data and navigation systems, his recent roles have not focused on routing tiling or critical data pipelines, raising concerns about immediate fit.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data processing (GISCollective project)
Experience with low-latency systems and real-time data handling (Dunnhumby)
Proven ability to build and maintain scalable, distributed systems
concerns: Limited experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are primary requirements for the role
No direct experience with routing tiling or navigation guidance solutions
Recent roles have focused on web/mobile development rather than geospatial data pipelines
